name: Master Sword
desc: The sword that seals the darkness. Glows near Malice.

name: Hylian Shield
desc: The iconic shield of the Hylian royal guard.

name: Traveler's Bow
desc: A basic bow used by travelers. Low damage but reliable.

name: Soldier's Claymore
desc: A two-handed sword issued to Hyrule's soldiers.

name: Flameblade
desc: A magical sword wreathed in flames. Deals fire damage.

name: Frostblade
desc: A sword imbued with ice. Freezes enemies on contact.

name: Thunderblade
desc: A sword crackling with electricity. Shocks enemies.

name: Ancient Short Sword
desc: A Sheikah-forged blade effective against Guardians.

name: Royal Guard's Shield
desc: A shield bearing the royal family crest.

name: Climbing Gear Set
desc: Armor that boosts climbing speed when worn as a set.
